items.difficulty_reason: Gorenstein equivalences for quasi-finite maps: (1)-(2) by definition, (3)-(4) by the construction of omega, and the core (1)-(2) iff (3)-(4) via two proofs - affine localization + the comparison lemma identifying omega as H^0 of f^!O_X closing with the duality lemmas, and a field-case reduction where omega_{B/k} = Hom_k(B,k) placed in degree 0 is the dualizing complex of the finite algebra. Retained author proof at lines 3523-3550.
